grouping.key: source scenario (scenario_id with the PT 'BR' segment stripped)
grouping.note: REQ-31 customer_id grouping is realised as the source scenario id (design D1); an ES row and its PT translation share one group and never cross the split boundary. No real customer ids or timestamps exist in the synthetic gold set.

time_ordering.note: The gold set was authored in two class-segregated waves (W1 servicing, W2 escalation/other), so splitting by wave alone would leave whole classes absent from a split. Class-stratification takes precedence for a usable split; the wave composition per split is reported below for transparency.
